'''Darth Maul's lair''' was a cave located within the depths of [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] came here looking for his [[Darth Maul/Legends|brother]].

==History==
At some point in between [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] traveled to Lotho Minor and made his home here. Living in seclusion Maul was driven to madness and became a local legend. After his betrayal at the hands of both [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], Opress located the lair using the [[Talisman of Finding/Legends|talisman]] given to him by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and a local [[Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan]] by the name of [[Morley/Legends|Morley]].

The cave was very harsh, full of junk and mist. Maul kept his residence in the end of the tunnel, in a large room, where he lived next to a huge fire.<ref name="Brothers" />

Maul had been feeding on [[Junker/Legends|Junkers]] and other living creatures, who were brought to him by Morley, in return for the leftovers. Opress found his own way inside the cave by accidently falling into it, after being betrayed by Morley. When Morley looked for the leftovers of Opress, he was choked to death by the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]], and his body was thrown onto the fire. Opress then found out that a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Jedi]] took his brother's legs.<ref name="Brothers" />

Maul was then brought back to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] where he was treated by Talzin.
